title: Entitled Rich Woman Abuses Cops, Doesn’t End Well
description:
On October 14th, 2023. Officers responded to a call regarding a highly intoxicated woman, who was causing a major disturbance at a hotel. Upon arrival, she became even more combative when they asked her to leave.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
